project: Young Israel of Cherry Hill Promo
emotionalArc: Warm invitation drawing young families into a vision of ideal Jewish suburban life, building confidence through concrete proof points — affordable homes, excellent schools, rich communal infrastructure — before resolving into belonging and a clear call home.

transition.description: Cold open on warm gold typography over deep navy; no previous scene to transition from

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Hails young Jewish families directly with a promise of belonging, creating an immediate emotional gap
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: There is a place where your family truly belongs
narrativeIntent.persuasion: Direct address / audience segmentation + Future pacing

scenes.script: Picture the community your family deserves.

transition.description: Soft dissolve from title typography into warm suburban imagery feel; gold accents carry through

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Paints the aspirational picture of Cherry Hill as an ideal place to raise a family
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Cherry Hill is nationally recognized as one of the best places to live

scenes.script: Cherry Hill — named one of America's best places to live.

transition.description: Directional slide right carrying the eye from suburban vision to a geographic context map feel

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Grounds the vision with practical geography — close to major Jewish centers
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Cherry Hill is minutes from Philly, an hour from Lakewood, close to NYC and Baltimore
narrativeIntent.persuasion: Friction reduction + Empirical proof & concrete numbers

scenes.script: Fifteen minutes from Philly. One hour from Lakewood. Close to everything.

transition.description: Slide continues rightward momentum; numbers appear as bold typographic callouts on warm background

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Delivers the affordability proof point that removes financial anxiety
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Beautiful homes from $300K to $580K — real affordability for young families

scenes.script: Beautiful homes, three hundred to five-eighty. Room to grow.

transition.description: Slide left introducing education theme; eye moves to warm imagery of learning

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Highlights excellent Jewish education options as a key family draw
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Excellent Jewish Day Schools and Yeshivas for your children

scenes.script: Excellent Jewish day schools and yeshivas for your children.

transition.description: Continuous slide maintaining cascade rhythm; icons or typographic list builds on screen

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Stacks communal infrastructure to prove this is a fully equipped frum community
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Eruv, mikvaos, kosher restaurants, a community kollel — everything you need

scenes.script: Eruv. Mikvaos. Kosher dining. A thriving community kollel.

scenes.sceneName: Young Families — You Are Not Alone

transition.description: Dissolve shifts tone from infrastructure list to warm human connection; softer palette moment

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Validates that young families are already choosing Cherry Hill — social proof through community
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: An abundance of young families already call this home

scenes.script: An abundance of young families already call this home.

transition.description: Dissolve into brand navy and gold; synagogue identity emerges as the anchor of community life

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Introduces Young Israel of Cherry Hill as the heart and anchor of this community
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Young Israel of Cherry Hill has served this community since 1996

scenes.script: Young Israel of Cherry Hill — serving this community since 1996.

transition.description: Soft dissolve deepens the personal tone; warm lighting feel as leadership is introduced

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Establishes spiritual depth and leadership under Rabbi Bienenfeld
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Under Rabbi Bienenfeld, the shul is a place of growth, joy, and togetherness

scenes.script: Led by Rabbi Bienenfeld — spiritual growth, joyful living, real connection.

transition.description: Slide upward lifts energy; triplet values appear as bold typographic beats

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Captures the shul's personality — not stiff, but warm and alive
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: This is a shul that is fun, engaging, and feels like family
narrativeIntent.persuasion: Rule of three (triplet structure) + Social belonging

scenes.script: Fun. Engaging. A community that feels like family.

transition.description: Dissolve into a centered, reverent typographic moment; Hebrew and English text share the frame

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Delivers the synagogue's unifying motto as an emotional climax — the philosophical center
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Kulanu K'echad — We Are All One

transition.description: Zoom pushes through the motto into a warm, inviting final frame with URL and call to action

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Converts emotional momentum into action — visit the site, start the journey home
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Come home to Cherry Hill — visit yicherryhill.com

scenes.script: Come home to Cherry Hill. Visit <cta>yicherryhill.com</cta>.
